cues.en: But we're gonna import pandas and PD and NumPy, read in the data file that we worked with, that cancer classification.

cues.zh: 接著建立模型。

cues.en: So we'll create the model.
cues.zh: 建立模型。

cues.en: I'm also going to add in the early stopping, but one notice or one thing to notice here is that we're importing an additional callback.

cues.zh: 這裡就得到筆記本所在的檔案路徑。

cues.en: All right, so now it's time to actually get to probably the most important part, which is creating this TensorBoard callback.
cues.zh: 好，現在進入可能最重要的部分，建立 TensorBoard 回呼。

cues.en: So again, TensorBoard, it's that visualization tool.
cues.zh: 再說一次，TensorBoard 是視覺化工具。

cues.en: And what's going to happen is this callback that we're going to create with this TensorBoard import, it's going to log a bunch of things, and it's up to you what it logs and what it doesn't log.
cues.zh: 我們透過匯入的 TensorBoard 建立回呼，它會記錄許多內容，而要記錄或不記錄什麼，由你決定。

cues.en: So it can log things like a training graph visualization, activation histograms, sample profiling, metrics summary plots, et cetera.
cues.zh: 可以記錄訓練計算圖、激活值直方圖、樣本效能分析、指標摘要圖等。

cues.en: So, there are various arguments that you pass when creating your TensorBoard callback variable to indicate whether or not you want to record something.
cues.zh: 建立 TensorBoard 回呼變數時，可以傳入各種引數，決定是否記錄某項資訊。

cues.en: So the most important one is right here, log directory, which is essentially the file path to the logs, and we'll show you how to fill that in in just a second.
cues.zh: 最重要的是 log_dir，也就是日誌的檔案路徑，等一下會示範怎麼填。

cues.en: The other ones are just whether or not you want to keep recording something.
cues.zh: 其他則是決定是否持續記錄某些內容。

cues.en: So the histogram frequency is the frequency in epochs at which to compute activation and weight histograms for the layers of the model.
cues.zh: histogram_freq 指定每隔多少個 epoch，計算模型各層的激活值與權重直方圖。

cues.en: So what we're going to do is we're going to set this to one so that basically after every epoch of training, we'll go ahead and calculate all the weights for our layers,
cues.zh: 我們設成一，所以每完成一個 epoch，就計算各層權重，

cues.en: and then we'll create a histogram of it.
cues.zh: 再建立直方圖。

cues.en: And then the next epoch, we'll do another histogram.
cues.zh: 下一個 epoch，再做另一張直方圖。

cues.en: So we'll actually be able to see these histograms essentially stacked on top of each other.
cues.zh: 實際上就能看到這些直方圖堆疊在一起。

cues.en: And we'll get this kind of cool 3D visualization that shows how the weights are essentially changing throughout the epochs of training.
cues.zh: 得到有趣的三維視覺化，顯示權重隨訓練 epoch 如何改變。

cues.en: And then if you want, you can also visualize the graph itself.
cues.zh: 如果想要，也能視覺化計算圖本身。

cues.en: So we can set right graph, and we can set that to true.
cues.zh: 設定 write_graph=True。

cues.en: We can also decide whether or not we want to write images, so whether to write model weights to visualize as an image in TensorBoard.
cues.zh: 也能決定是否 write_images，將模型權重寫成影像，在 TensorBoard 顯示。

cues.en: And then the update frequency is also something you can choose.
cues.zh: update_freq 也能自行設定。

cues.en: Typically, I would recommend updating per epoch.
cues.zh: 通常我建議每個 epoch 更新。

cues.en: It's usually easier to interpret that way.
cues.zh: 這樣比較容易解讀。

cues.en: And then finally, we can also specify a profile batch.
cues.zh: 最後還能指定 profile_batch。

cues.en: So we can profile the batch to sample compute characteristics.
cues.zh: 對批次做效能分析，取樣計算特性。

cues.en: By default, we can profile by the second batch, so we'll keep it on that default.
cues.zh: 預設分析第二個批次，所以保留預設值。

cues.en: And then embeddings frequency is the frequency in epochs at which embedding layers will be visualized.
cues.zh: embeddings_freq 指定每隔多少個 epoch，視覺化嵌入層。

cues.en: If you set that to zero, you won't bother with visualizing those embeddings.
cues.zh: 設成零，就不會視覺化那些嵌入。

cues.en: So lots of different things there.
cues.zh: 所以有很多不同設定。

cues.en: The other thing to note here is if you're running this model multiple times with different parameters, and you want to make sure you have different directories
cues.zh: 另一點，如果用不同參數重複執行模型，想讓每次執行都有不同目錄，

cues.en: for each time you run this model, what I recommend doing, and this is also the exact same thing they set up in the official tutorial, you'll notice as you scroll down, they'll set it up with a date timestamp.
cues.zh: 我建議使用日期時間戳記，官方教學也是這樣設定，往下捲會看到。

cues.en: So right here, they call date time, datetime.
cues.zh: 這裡呼叫 datetime 的 datetime。

cues.en: Essentially what that does is if you say from datetime, import datetime, and then you say, let me just zoom in here so you can see this clearly, datetime dot now, and then structure the time
cues.zh: 基本上，使用 from datetime import datetime，再呼叫 datetime.now；我放大一點，方便看清楚，再用這個指令，

cues.en: with this particular command, you'll get this string, which indicates today's date and the hour.
cues.zh: 格式化時間，就會得到表示今天日期與時間的字串。

cues.en: And what you can do is have that be the name of your folder.
cues.zh: 可以把它當成資料夾名稱。

cues.en: That way, as long as you wait one minute before running your model again, you'll have a unique log for each time you run the model.
cues.zh: 這樣只要相隔一分鐘再執行模型，每次就能有唯一的日誌。

cues.en: That way you can go back, edit the number of neurons in a layer, et cetera, and visualize each of those models with TensorBoard.
cues.zh: 就能回頭修改層內神經元數等設定，再用 TensorBoard 比較各個模型。

cues.en: Now in our case, we're only going to run this one time, so we'll go ahead and just set our log directory to logs.
cues.zh: 我們這裡只執行一次，所以把 log_dir 設為 logs。

cues.zh: 所以我應該使用雙反斜線。
